portal_hypertension.title: Variceal hemorrhage in cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：本综述讨论了 VB 的风险分层管理和预防，包括急性治疗、经颈静脉肝内门体分流术 (TIPS) 的适应症以及特定阶段的一级和二级预防。 临床提示：静脉曲张出血（VB）是肝硬化失代偿的一个决定性事件，并且仍然是发病和死亡的原因。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Variceal bleeding (VB) is a defining event of decompensation in cirrhosis and remains cause of morbidity and mortality. The presence of other decompensating events determines management and prognosis. This review discusses risk-stratified management and prevention of VB, including acute therapy, indications for transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS), and stage-specific primary and secondary prophylaxis. A PubMed/MEDLINE search prioritized trials, meta-analyses, and guidelines. Expert Opinion: In patients presenting with VB, standard management consists of vasoconstrictive drugs, antibiotics, and endoscopic variceal ligation (EVL). portal_hypertension.title: Tryptophan depletion generates hyper-reactive portal neutrophils in alcoholic liver disease.
portal_hypertension.authors: Reinartz Groba S, Richter M, Schwarz D
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：中性粒细胞保证宿主对病原体做出迅速而有力的反应。 临床提示：在酒精相关性肝病（ALD）中，中性粒细胞发挥着核心作用，因此调节中性粒细胞活性的机制构成了可能的治疗靶点。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Neutrophils guarantee a prompt and robust host response to pathogens. Yet, overshooting neutrophil activation leads to tremendous collateral damage in tissues. In advanced chronic liver disease (ACLD), neutrophils are exposed to the highly immunogenic milieu of the portal circulation prior to entering the liver sinusoids. In alcohol-related liver disease (ALD), neutrophils occupy a central role and therefore mechanisms regulating neutrophil activity pose a possible therapeutic target. Evaluate the impact of the portal milieu on neutrophils in ACLD with portal hypertension. portal_hypertension.title: POEMS Syndrome Presenting as Porto-Sinusoidal Vascular Disease: A Case Report.
portal_hypertension.journal: Clinics and research in hepatology and gastroenterology
portal_hypertension.authors: Zhang H, Quan X, Wu H
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：泼尼松和来那度胺治疗显着改善了他的腹水，消除了 TIPS 的需要。 临床提示：POEMS 综合征最初表现为门脉高压，这种情况很少见。
portal_hypertension.abstract: POEMS syndrome presenting initially as portal hypertension is rare. We report a 49-year-old man who was initially diagnosed with cryptogenic cirrhosis and refractory ascites. Liver biopsy later revealed Porto-sinusoidal Vascular Disease (PSVD), rather than cirrhosis. During the follow-up, he developed polyneuropathy, organomegaly, endocrinopathy, and skin changes. Further evaluation confirmed POEMS syndrome with elevated vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) and IgA monoclonal gammopathy. Treatment with prednisone and lenalidomide significantly improved his ascites, eliminating the need for TIPS.
